parameters.content:
## Telegram Spotify player

One text message -> model search query -> first matching track -> queue -> next -> resume -> observed status -> Telegram reply. Configure Telegram, the model, all Spotify nodes and the Spotify OAuth credential on the current-state HTTP read. Spotify Premium and an active device are required. Restrict trusted Telegram users as appropriate.

Commands are sequential requests, but Spotify does not guarantee Player API execution ordering. Inspect the reported current item. No workflow-level retries or deduplication. A failed write can leave playback changed; check before repeating. Resume failure still proceeds to reading current state, as in the source.

Model gpt-4o-mini is scheduled to retire January 14, 2027; update configuration before that date. See README for account scopes, failures and changes.
